sentences.text:
(Mithun @ Vishnu Vs The State Of M.P And Ot
 Dated : 16-04-2024
 Shri R.S. Yadav - Advocate for the appellant.
 Shri S.K. Kashyap - Government Advocate for respondent
1. Appellant has filed I.A. No.8580/2024 an application under Section 389(1) of Code of Criminal Procedure for suspension of jail sentence.

2. Appellant has been convicted under Sections 506, 376(2)(i) of the IPC read with Section 4 of the POCSO Act read with Section 3(2)(v) of the SC/ST Act and sentenced to undergo R.I. for six months and ten years with fine of Rs.1000/- and Rs.4000/- respectively, with default stipulations.
3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the appellant that appellant is in jail since 21.03.2019 for about 05 years.
Appeal is pending since 2021.
There is no likelihood of hearing of appeal in near future.
Trial Court has committed an error in convicting the appellant.
Appellant has already undergone 50% of the jail sentence.
4 . Learned Government Advocate opposed the application for suspension of sentence.
It is submitted that offence is serious in nature.

5. Heard the counsel for the parties.
6.
Considering the aforesaid and period of jail sentence which has already been undergone by the appellant, I.A. No.8580/2024 for suspension of sentence is allowed.

7. It is hereby directed that the custodial sentence awarded to the appellant shall remain suspended during the pendency of this appeal and on deposit of fine amount, if already not deposited, he shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety bond of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 11.07.2024 and on other dates as may be fixed in this regard till final disposal of this appeal.
8. List the appeal for final hearing in due course.
C.C. as per rules.
